outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel B shows fluorescence, H&E and bright-field images (micrographs), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a bar chart of lactate concentration with mean and 95% CI, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid on each bar for Normal lung, LUAD, and LUSC groups.
Panel D is a bar chart of lactate concentration with mean and 95% CI, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid on the High pH and Low pH bars.
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, not a plot of averaged data.
